name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 10 · décrocher, adopter, fondre
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (boy with worn-out trainers, man unhooking the wall telephone beside a crocheting granny, family adopting a scruffy puppy on the balcony, Sue deleting her paper pile with the red button at the upper window, woman succumbing to sleep on the roof-terrace bench, comb dropped), -re RIGHT (snowman in sunglasses melting on his sun lounger). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
